messages.content: You can call create_event to add an appointment to the user's calendar.
Add a meeting with the marketing team tomorrow at 2 PM for one hour in the main conference room.

message.content:
<think>The user wants to add a meeting with the marketing team tomorrow at 2 PM for one hour in the main conference room.

Tomorrow's date: 2024-03-27
Start time: 14:00 (2 PM)
Duration: 60 minutes (1 hour)
Location: main conference room
Attendees: marketing team (I'll include this as an attendee)

Let me create the event with these details.
</think>


<minimax:tool_call>
<invoke name="create_event">
<parameter name="title">Meeting with marketing team</parameter>
<parameter name="start_iso">2024-03-27T14:00:00</parameter>
<parameter name="duration_minutes">60</parameter>
<parameter name="location">Main Conference Room</parameter>
<parameter name="attendees">["marketing team"]</parameter>
</invoke>
</minimax:tool_call>
